journeys.title: In a tribe, nothing done yet

emails.subject: Your season has begun, {first_name}
paragraphs: {tribe} has started its twelve weeks, and you’re part of it.
This week’s guide is ready, and your first small step is waiting to be chosen.

emails.subject: Your first step, in one sentence
paragraphs: Each week you choose one small step: “When ___, I will ___.” It takes a minute.
Only you see what you write; your leader sees only whether it’s done. Your tribe meets {meets}.

emails.subject: Your tribe saved you a seat
paragraphs: Come to the next meeting on {next_meeting}, even if you haven’t done anything else yet. {leader_first} will give you a call this week too.
Twelve weeks go quickly, and the people in {tribe} are working on the same goal as you.

emails.subject: We’ve missed you in {tribe}
paragraphs: If something is in the way, whether the time, the place or something harder, tap below and someone from the care team will reach out.
If you need to step back this season, you can tell us that too.
This is our last email about getting started; from here {leader_first} will stay in touch personally.

journeys.title: Started a leader application, not finished

emails.subject: Thank you for thinking about leading a tribe
paragraphs: Being willing to walk with others through a season is a gift to this church.
You’ve started an application to lead a tribe, and it’s saved exactly as you left it.

emails.subject: What’s left on your leader application
paragraphs: Have your two referees’ names and numbers ready: each gets a private link once you send it.
You can speak your answers instead of typing them.
You have {parts_left} parts left, about {minutes_left} minutes.

emails.subject: Every tribe starts with one person willing to go first
paragraphs: The Leader Academy trains every leader, and a coach walks with you, before a single member arrives.
You don’t need to have it all figured out.

emails.subject: Last reminder about your leader application
paragraphs: If this isn’t your season to lead, that’s alright, and there are other ways to serve. Tell us with one tap and we won’t ask again.
This is the last time we’ll remind you. {close_line}

emails.subject: You’re part-way to your tribe, {first_name}
paragraphs: About five more minutes and you’ll see three tribes that fit you.
You started telling us about your season, and your answers are saved just as you left them.

emails.subject: Five minutes, and your tribe is waiting
paragraphs: If a question is unclear, reply to this email and someone on the team will help.
Nothing you wrote is lost. You can finish on your phone in about five minutes.

emails.subject: There’s a seat with your name on it
paragraphs: In a tribe of twelve there is someone working on the same thing you are. Finish your form and we’ll introduce you.
United Tribes exists so that nobody at The Covenant Nation walks through a season alone.

emails.subject: Your answers will be cleared on {erase_date}
paragraphs: If now isn’t the right time, that’s fine: tell us with one tap and we won’t remind you again.
This is our last reminder.
To protect your privacy, an unfinished form is cleared after 30 days, so your answers will be removed on {erase_date}.

journeys.title: Finished the form, not in a tribe

emails.subject: Your three tribes are ready, {first_name}
paragraphs: Thank you for finishing your form.
We found three tribes that fit your season, each with how well it matches you and why. Have a look and choose the one you’d love to walk with.

emails.subject: Choosing a tribe takes two minutes
paragraphs: A tribe holds twelve, so your favourite may fill. You can change your mind any time before the season starts on {season_starts}.
Open a tribe to see who leads it, when and where it meets, and what it hopes for by week 12.

emails.subject: {tribe_1} still has a seat for you
paragraphs: Joining before the first meeting means you start the season together.
Your best match, {tribe_1}, led by {leader_first}, has {seats_left} seats left.

emails.subject: Last call to join a tribe this season
paragraphs: If none of your three tribes feels right, tell us and we’ll look again. If this isn’t your season, that’s fine too.
Joining closes on {joining_closes}; after that the next chance is next season.
